_comment: MyIotSan distribution defaults — the on-prem IoT device hub ('the NVR, but for sensors'). Safe to edit. On first run a strong jwt.secret is generated and saved here, a self-signed TLS certificate is generated into ./certs (so the app serves HTTPS on :3003 immediately — browsers show a one-time trust warning on a LAN), and a one-time superadmin password is generated and written to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt in the data dir. This file lives in the app's data dir; runtime changes made in the UI are persisted back to it. NOTE: this app opens an MQTT broker on 1883 (mqtt.addr below) — no other product in this suite listens on that port, so it must be allowed through the host firewall for devices to connect.

localAuth._comment: An empty password makes the first run generate a strong per-install one (printed to the log and saved to INITIAL_ADMIN_LOGIN.txt). Set LOCAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD to override. NEVER ship a shared default here — this appliance can actuate relays, so a known default password is a fleet-wide backdoor.

pairing._comment: Fleet pairing with a MySeliaSan control plane. These ports MUST match the control plane's — the 3953x range below is the shipped default across the suite; a node and a parent that disagree never reconnect. mtlsPort is THIS node's management listener (the parent dials it for heartbeat/release); controlPort/mediaPort are the PARENT's ports that this node dials out to.

mqtt._comment: The embedded MQTT broker devices publish telemetry to. A device that is not in the inventory (or presenting a valid enrollment-window key) cannot connect at all — the device table IS the credential store. 0.0.0.0 listens on every interface; narrow it to a specific LAN address if the host is multi-homed.

telemetry_store._comment: The batched writer between the broker and SQLite. batchSize/flushMs trade write amplification against latency; queueSize is the backpressure bound. rawRetentionDays purges per-reading rows; rollupRetentionDays keeps the aggregates far longer (they are tiny).

securityHeaders.contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' blob: mediastream:; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self' blob:; frame-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
